title: Reservation-Selection Recorded Capacity Arithmetic
purpose: Purely align canonical FOOD-007F exact capacity-source values with a successful canonical FOOD-007K recorded-held commitment resolution and compute a signed same-exact-revision arithmetic delta.
dependencies: FOOD-007B exact-SKU stocked capacity-source structural validation
algorithm: Strictly capture the relevant FOOD-007F selection/source evidence and validate each durable source through its canonical source-domain validator.
Strictly capture the relevant FOOD-007K validation and recorded-held commitment evidence.
Require identical SKU counts and exact per-index SKU id, SKU version and capacity revision alignment.
Require exact fulfillment method, location reference, window reference and capacity revision alignment.
Require FOOD-007K validation observations to agree with its commitment observations and require selected revision to equal observed highest recorded revision.
For each aligned exact revision compute recordedCapacityDelta = capacityUnits - recordedHeldQuantity.
Use BigInt subtraction and reject any result outside the signed JavaScript safe-integer range.
Preserve negative arithmetic exactly; never clamp negative values to zero.
Return a deeply frozen detached result.

output.skuArithmetic: Exact SKU identity/revision plus capacityUnits, recordedHeldQuantity and signed recordedCapacityDelta.
output.slotArithmetic: Exact slot identity/revision plus capacityUnits, recordedHeldQuantity and signed recordedCapacityDelta.

negativeArithmetic: Negative recordedCapacityDelta is preserved as arithmetic evidence and is not clamped.
safeClaim: For each structurally aligned exact capacity-source revision, recordedCapacityDelta is the mathematical difference between that recorded source assertion's capacityUnits and FOOD-007K's recordedHeldQuantity for the same exact revision.
authorityBoundary: recordedCapacityDelta is neutral arithmetic evidence only. It is not remaining capacity, available capacity, reservable quantity, ATP, capacity sufficiency, active capacity, governing capacity or acceptance authority.
crossRevisionBoundary: No commitment from one capacity-source revision is rolled into another capacity-source revision.
lifecycleBoundary: FOOD-007L does not decide whether recorded held rows are currently active after any future release, expiration, cancellation, replacement, rescheduling or consumption lifecycle.
concurrencyBoundary: FOOD-007L performs no reads. It composes the already-obtained input artifacts and does not upgrade their read-time observations into a simultaneous or perpetual snapshot.
physicalInventoryBoundary: No physical quantity on hand or physical inventory movement is established.
sideEffects: Pure synchronous composition. No database access, SQL, writes, routes, clocks, network access, environment access, randomness, reservation mutation, acceptance construction, migration execution or production mutation.
